notes.title: Patch 1.03 Details
notes.content:
Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition is back with a brand new update adding additional language support!

Patch 1.03 - New Features

Language Support - We've added French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese. New languages can be set by accessing the title's "Properties" menu in the Steam Library and navigating to the "Language" tab.


- WayForward

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Details
notes.content:
This new update includes the following: 

Bug Fixes
Fixed issue where Avast antivirus detects the game as malware and deletes it.
    Fixed Korean text being displayed incorrectly on the Leaderboards.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Details
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition. This new update includes the following: 

Bug Fixes
Fixed issue with improper leaderboard messaging.
    Minor fixes to particle effect behavior and game credits.


Known Issues
Temporarily took out the use of Japanese text (working on a fix currently).
